llm.summary: The skill's code and declared requirements mostly match an Upbit trading bot, but key implementation files (notably the Upbit client / config loader) were not fully visible in the provided content — you should inspect those before trusting your API keys/funds.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, SKILL.md, package.json, and the majority of source files consistently implement an Upbit automated trading bot. Requested binaries (node) and env vars (UPBIT_ACCESS_KEY, UPBIT_SECRET_KEY) are appropriate for the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions (monitor_once, worker_once, smoke_test) and the code operate on local resource files (resources/*.json) and call Upbit API endpoints (/accounts, /orders/chance, tickers, candles). That behavior aligns with the bot's purpose. The skill also spawns local Node processes in tests and reads/writes local files — expected for this application. However, the review was truncated and did not include the full content of all files (notably the Upbit client and some config code), so it's not possible to confirm there is no hidden network behavior or exfiltration in those files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No custom install spec in the skill bundle (instruction-only for OpenClaw), but repository contains a standard package.json and common dependencies (axios, jsonwebtoken, uuid). Installing with npm is standard; nothing in the manifest indicates downloads from untrusted URLs or archive extraction.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires only the Upbit API credentials (UPBIT_ACCESS_KEY, UPBIT_SECRET_KEY) which are proportionate and declared as primaryEnv. No unrelated secrets or broad system credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and will not force inclusion. It writes only to its own resources/ files (events.json, positions.json, caches) and uses simple lock files. It does not appear to modify other skills or global agent settings in the visible files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package appears to implement a real automated Upbit trading bot and requests only Upbit API keys (which is expected). Before installing or handing over keys: 1) Inspect the Upbit client implementation (scripts/execution/upbitClient.js) and config loader (scripts/config/index.js) for any hardcoded remote endpoints, telemetry, or hidden data uploads — these files were truncated in the provided content and are critical. 2) Run the skill with execution.dryRun=true and test using the included test scripts to ensure behavior is as expected. 3) Store API keys in the platform's secure secret store (OpenClaw Skills Config) rather than a local config.json. 4) Limit the API key permissions (use read-only where possible during testing, or use an account with minimal funds) and monitor activity on your Upbit account closely. If you cannot review the missing files, treat the keys as high-risk and do not provide production credentials.
